description:
The Rapide Carbon is designed to be fast!

The race proven Rapide Carbon transfers the power directly to where you need it, providing rapid response and sharp handling to make sure you complete the hottest lap. This bike has already raced in some of the biggest XC races, as well as prove itself on the demanding marathon epics. The Rapide Carbon is your perfect podium hunter

The Rapide CRX is built to be fast, light, and performance led. With the race winning 100mm Rockshox SID Ultimate forks with OneLoc remote to lock out suspension on the fly providing maximum speed on the climbs. Shimano's performance 1x12 XT wide range drivetrain ensures you have enough gears for even the steepest climbs. Shimano's M8100 brakes give you enough stopping power for the rewarding descents.

This race machine rolls on WTB KOM Light rims paired with a Schwalbe Racing Ray/Racing Ralph tyre combo for a perfect blend of speed and grip. Ritchey WCS components complete this race ready XC bike.

Rockshox SID Ultimate 110mm W/ Oneloc
